mods.name: Minecraft Weapons
mods.description: Animated guns with a first-person viewmodel, built on GeckoLib.

releases.notes:
**Install:** put `mcweapons-0.1.0.jar` in the `mods` folder, on the client and on the server, of a Fabric instance for Minecraft 26.3 (Java 25), with:
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API 0.164.0+26.3 or newer
- GeckoLib 5.5.7 or newer (Fabric, 26.3)

Optional: LambDynamicLights, for muzzle flashes that light up the surroundings.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/compare/v0.1.0-r79...v0.1.0-r82

## What's Changed
* Bigger 1v1 arena: inside x 40 to 100, z -34 to 26 (61 by 61, was 21 by 29) with more cover, still the same turned half round; a survival player's name is drawn like a sneaking one's, so it no longer shows through walls by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/96


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/compare/v0.1.0-r65...v0.1.0-r71

## What's Changed
* Toggle aim key by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/59
* Scopes looked through like real ones: a second camera, a refracting lens, eye distance per scope by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/60
* Scopes drawn once: zoomed view + lens pass, fast under shader packs by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/61
* Lit reticles one size on screen; reticle size slider by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/62
* Defaults: reticle size 45%, eye distance 80% for PU and ACOG by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/63
* Hold breath while aiming (hold + toggle keys), limited breath with vignette by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/64
* Guns show their 3D model with attachments in the inventory, dropped, in frames and on displays by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/65
* Breath sounds: hold, release, gasp when out of breath by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/66
* Scope reticles the right way up (ACOG ladder, PU post) by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/67
* A removed attachment no longer comes back after its detach animation by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/68
* The Mosin keeps a round in the chamber (5 + 1) by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/69
* Shots leave along the barrel as drawn, from its tip by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/70
* Sway from the tuner on both guns, stronger up/down lag by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/71
* Inspects show the chamber (Glock press check, mag check ends in one, hollow Mosin chamber) by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/72
* 1v1 arena on the test server (survival inside, respawn on the safest pad) by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/73
* Arena rebuild loads the lobby chunk where its sign stands by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/74
* Hollow bores, Glock press check from the top, first-person size in third person, practice world in git by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/75
* Polish every animation: forearms turn with what they hold, elbows drag, the gun settles, Glock hands solved by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/76
* Mosin longer and thicker in first person, twice as long in third person, carried two-handed at the hip by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/77
* An M4A1: semi, burst and auto, quad rails, its own sounds and animations by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/78
* M4A1 attachments: muzzle devices, optics, 45-round mag, grips, laser and flashlight by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/79
* M4A1: thin rear sight, auto by default, magazine swaps fill the magazine by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/80
* Clear 1x sight picture over the front sight, eye distance for 1x sights by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/81
* M4A1: rear sight just a ring, iron sight line lower by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/82
* M4A1: real rails, rounder parts, more details, no z-fighting by @NoxLoveYa in https://github.com/NoxLoveYa/Minecraft-Weapons/pull/83
